name: Hairy Indian Mallow
desc: Hairy Indian Mallow (Abutilon grandifolium): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Abutilon grandifolium, the hairy Indian mallow, is a large shrub that is up to 3 m (9.8 ft) high with broad, 3–18 cm (1.2–7.1 in) leaf blades.
